Far, far away, in a universe deep as an eye's pupil,
hangs a beautiful world like red lips.
It is the world of hope told of in legend...
Hidden in the Great Red Galaxy, where high humans,
beastmen and spirits meet: Hongqi, the Three Realms.
Legend says whoever reaches the world of Hongqi
will gain wisdom, wealth, life and power...
The story begins in the year 1660 of the Ya Era,
with the Bangpei Empire, ruler of half of Hongqi.
Kaluoan, Bangpei's handsome eleven-year-old prince,
chasing a huge tiger beast in a royal hunt,
fell into a valley. Badly hurt, near death,
he was saved by Niguduo, who lived in the valley.
Cared for two months by Nadi, Niguduo's daughter,
Kaluoan slowly healed, and at last left their home.
But Nadi had fallen hopelessly for the prince.
Kept apart by rank, she could not see him again,
and the prince never forgot the one who saved him.
Ten years on, the old king died; Kaluoan was crowned.
At the council choosing the mage-priests,
Kaluoan saw Nadi........
To see Kaluoan again, Nadi had studied magic hard,
and learned Heaven's Mirror, the mage-priests' art.
Nadi did not let Kaluoan down;
her matchless magic made her the Archmage.
But a mage-priest must give up love,
and Nadi suffered: near him, with him, never loved.
For her past kindness, Kaluoan treated her well.
The year 1680 of the Ya Era.
Kaluoan married a princess of the Yatelan Empire,
and the next year a son was born, named Hudu.
Nadi, twenty years in love alone, grew jealous,
and hid it deep in her narrow heart.
At the feast of Prince Hudu's first birthday,
a beastman's horn grew from his forehead.
Besides Nadi, no one else saw it happen.
For the once-kind King Kaluoan,
to hide that the queen "might" love a beastman,
put every guest in the hall to death.
In the slaughter Nadi the Archmage was wounded,
and the beauty of her face was ruined.
For revenge, Nadi the Archmage
led the seven best mages and Mount Wuta's beastmen
to war against Kaluoan.
On the fifth day the king and queen took their lives,
but Nadi did not stop her attack;
her cruelty only grew.
Not content to destroy mankind,
she overturned the world with sorcery and science.
At last Nadi was sealed by five godlike warriors,
but the affair of the horn was guessed at again,
and became a mystery never solved.
